entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.135 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376-D IPC and Section 5(G)/6 of POCSO Act and Sections 3(2)(V) of SC/ST Act, Police Station Visheshwargang , District Bahraich.

3. It is argued by counsel for applicant that the one of the co-accused namely Ashfak against whom similar allegations have been levelled has been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 19.7.2023.

Nizam vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home And 3 ... on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187706646/
1 4.

entities.text: Nizam vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home And 3
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned AGA vehemently opposes the bail application.

5. Considering the fact that the allegations levelled against the applicant are similar to one levelled against Ashfak one of the co-accused and the applicant has no previous criminal antecedent and,
thus, on ground of parity, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.

6. 6. Let the applicant Nizam be released on bail inCase Crime No.135 of 2023, under Sections 363,
366, 376-D IPC and Section 5(G)/6 of POCSO Act and Sections 3(2)(V) of SC/ST Act, Police Station Visheshwargang , District Bahraich on his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.

Order Date :- 21.7.2023 -Amit K-
